extrasMotivation: Minima (n=1, n=2, unit and 10^9 heights); flat rows where the answer is width-limited (n+1)//2 vs height-limited; single-column valleys splitting plateaus; pyramids; ten maximum n=10^5 rows (all 10^9 -> 50000, unit, alternating, increasing/decreasing staircases that drive quadratic propagation, exact pyramid, central split, noisy near-max, full-range random, heights near the width bound); fixed-seed small rows checkable by literal simulation; medium mixed-scale rows; perturbed pyramids. Unit tests port 8 selected WRONG_ANSWER sources to Python (author ports, not executed originals) and assert each is killed by at least one extra.
generatedBasis: Not claimed. Official suite is incomplete (18/41); authored extras are supplementary, and any generated basis requires the parent 5AC/5WA plus sixth-oracle qualification and later different-agent audit.

independentChecks.distanceFormula: O(n^2) min(i+1, n-i, min_j h_j+|i-j|) on 600 fixed-seed rows n<=250 with heights up to 10^9.
independentChecks.literalSimulation: Cell-set simulation of the statement rule (block kept iff top, bottom-or-floor, left and right neighbours all present), applied simultaneously until empty. Exhaustive n=1..5 with h in 1..5 and n=6 with h in 1..4 (8001 rows), plus 1500 fixed-seed rows n<=14, h<=10.

officialReview.note: All 18 official CRLF pairs and 2 samples parse within constraints and match the oracle. Row holds 18 of 41 official tests (largest n=170); no malformed upstream pair or contradiction. Row reports generated_tests=12 (not included in input; not reviewed).

oracle: O(n): L_i=min(L_{i-1}+1,h_i), R_i=min(R_{i+1}+1,h_i), answer max_i min(L_i,R_i).
parse: Exactly two lines (optional final LF; CRLF accepted per line): line 1 n as [1-9][0-9]*, line 2 exactly n tokens [1-9][0-9]* separated by single spaces; 1<=n<=10^5, 1<=h_i<=10^9. Rejects leading/trailing/double spaces, tabs, signs, leading zeros, extra lines, count mismatch.
role: recipe-author (not an independent audit, not a qualification, no signoff)

authorObservationsNonBinding: TLE sources 12761473, 12761879 and 12761129 use propagation that is quadratic on monotone staircases; maxSize extras include such rows but TLE is not algorithmic proof.

Ported WRONG_ANSWER ideas (12761046, 12761891, 12761564, 12759818, 12760110, 12762143, 12762029, 12761207) each disagree with the oracle on at least one authored extra; several are killed only by n=1 or n<=2 edge columns. Parent auditor must judge sandboxed originals; author makes no claim on counted wrong sources.

semantics: Line 1: n, 1<=n<=10^5; line 2: n integers h_i, 1<=h_i<=10^9 (public English statement shows 10<sup>5</sup>/10<sup>9</sup>; pinned row flattened them to 105/109). Each operation simultaneously destroys every block lacking a block or floor on any of its four sides; print the unique integer number of operations until no block remains. Oracle: L_i=min(L_{i-1}+1,h_i), R_i=min(R_{i+1}+1,h_i) with zero outside the row; answer max_i min(L_i,R_i). Literal cell-set simulation exhaustively cross-checks small rows and an O(n^2) distance formula min(i+1,n-i,min_j h_j+|i-j|) cross-checks large heights.
